DisplayField.SubQuery: select distinct on (w.id) w.id as session_id, w.externalid, w.wrk_workflowdata_id, w.pipeline_name , w.status, w.status ||'#' || w.wrk_workflowdata_id AS widstatus from wrk_workflowdata w where replace(replace(w.pipeline_name, '.', '_'),' ','_')='@WHERE' order by w.id,launch_time desc

SELECT xnat_experimentdata_id AS session_id, label, file_size FROM xnat_abstractResource abst JOIN xnat_experimentdata_resource res ON abst.xnat_abstractresource_id=res.xnat_abstractresource_xnat_abstractresource_id WHERE label='@WHERE' ORDER BY xnat_experimentdata_id

SELECT xnat_experimentdata_id AS session_id, label, file_count FROM xnat_abstractResource abst JOIN xnat_experimentdata_resource res ON abst.xnat_abstractresource_id=res.xnat_abstractresource_xnat_abstractresource_id WHERE label='@WHERE' ORDER BY xnat_experimentdata_id
